Based on body size, calculate respiration rate (DIC) and carbon demand (ingestion rate) and resulting egestion (POC-fecal pellets). Compare this with the NPP estimated.


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Load libraries and data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# LPC flux results
load("data/comparison_net_uvp_abundance_20260508.RData")
rm(df.100m.conc, df.profile, df.station.100m)

# Individual level traits
load("data/uvp6_images_calculated_traits_20260321.RData")
```

# Calculate active respiration rates and organize to profiles
```{r}
# Coefficients of the ACTIVE respiration equation (Maps et al. 2014):
bb <- 7.81 # Metabolic constant (x 10-7)
eV <- 0.53 # Activation energy
bb_se <- 0.58  # Standard error of the metabolic constant
eV_se <- 0.065 # Standard error of the activation energy

# Use surface temperatures maybe?
load("data/uvp6_associated_ctd_20260330.RData")
rm(ctd, ctd_profiles, temp_profiles)

AA <- Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
  arrange(-maxSampleDepth) %>% 
  distinct(station_year, .keep_all = T)

BB <- uvp6_ctd_match %>% 
  filter(sample_id %in% AA$sample_id)

CC <- temp_profiles_100 %>% 
  filter(filename %in% BB$ctd_filename) %>% 
  filter(depth_bin <= 200) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(temp.mean)) %>% 
  left_join(BB %>% 
              select(filename = ctd_filename, region),
            by = "filename") %>% 
  left_join(region_rename %>% 
              select(region, region.inuk), by = "region") %>% 
  # Calculate average per profile
  group_by(filename, region.inuk, station, datetime) %>% 
  summarise(temperature_upper200 = mean(temp.mean),
            .groups = "drop") 

# Calculate average per region
temp.regions <- CC %>% 
  group_by(region.inuk) %>% 
  summarise(temperature_mean = mean(temperature_upper200),
            temperature_sd = sd(temperature_upper200),
            n = n(),
            .groups = "drop")

rm(AA, BB, CC, uvp6_ctd_match, temp_profiles_100)


# The respiration rate is based on total biomass (structural + lipid)
indiv_traits_v2 <- indiv_traits %>% 
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") %>% 
  filter(sample_id %in% Amund_UVP6_meta$sample_id) %>% 
  mutate(total_mass_ugC = prosome_total_mgC * 1000) %>% 
  select(object_id, sample_id, object_depth_max,
         total_mass_ugC, prosome_length_mm, temperature_kelvin,
         diapause_respirationRate_ugCday = respirationRate_ugCday) %>% 
  left_join(distinct(Amund_UVP6_meta, sample_id, 
                     station_year, region.inuk, Year, DOY),
            by = "sample_id") %>% 
  left_join(temp.regions %>% select(-n), by = join_by(region.inuk)) %>% 
  # Change temperature_kelvin to the surface mean temp for the region
  mutate(temperature_kelvin = temperature_mean + 273.15) %>% 
  # Calculate respiration rate at upper 200 m
  mutate(active_respirationRate_ugCday = 
           (bb*10^-7 ) * (total_mass_ugC^0.75) * 
           exp(eV * (temperature_kelvin-273)/ 
                 ((8.62*10^-5)*temperature_kelvin*273)) * 86400) %>% 
  
  # Calculate Ingestion rate assuming assimilation efficiency of 70% and gross growth efficiency of 30% (Ikeda & Motoda 1978 as used in Darnis & Fortier 2012 for Amundsen Gulf). I.e. 30% of ingested carbon is egested as fecal pellets?
  mutate(ingestionRate_ugCday_v1 = (100/(70-30)) * active_respirationRate_ugCday,
         egestionRate_ugCday_v1 = ingestionRate_ugCday_v1 * 0.30) %>%
  # If using AE of 47% (as used in Jenkins et al. 2022 & their calculated mean production growth of 10%), so 53% is egested as fecal pellets
  mutate(ingestionRate_ugCday_v2 = (100/(47-10)) * active_respirationRate_ugCday,
         egestionRate_ugCday_v2 = ingestionRate_ugCday_v2 * 0.53) 


# Convert to station_year then integrate to get the total water column rates (express in g C m-2 d-1)

# Step 1. Calculate abundance, biomass, and respiration in 100 m bins
# 1.1 Integrate volume of water sampled to 100 m depth bins
volumes.df.100 <- volumes.df %>% 
  mutate(Depth_100m = floor(Depth_5m / 100) * 100) %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, Depth_100m) %>% 
  summarise(n5mbins = n(),
            Sampled_volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(depth_height_m = 5 * n5mbins) %>% 
  select(-c(n5mbins))
  
  
 # 1.2 Sum all individuals and C traits in a 100 m depth bin
  
rates_profiles <- indiv_traits_v2 %>% 
    # bin to 100 m layers
    mutate(Depth_100m = floor(object_depth_max/100) * 100) %>% 
    # Summarize traits
    group_by(sample_id, Depth_100m, station_year, region.inuk) %>% 
    summarise(abundance = n(),
              biomass_ugC = sum(total_mass_ugC),
              diapause_respirationRate_ugCday = sum(diapause_respirationRate_ugCday),
              active_respirationRate_ugCday = sum(active_respirationRate_ugCday),
              ingestionRate_ugCday_v1 = sum(ingestionRate_ugCday_v1),
              egestionRate_ugCday_v1 = sum(egestionRate_ugCday_v1),
              ingestionRate_ugCday_v2 = sum(ingestionRate_ugCday_v2),
              egestionRate_ugCday_v2 = sum(egestionRate_ugCday_v2),
              .groups = "drop")


  # 1.3 Calculate concentrations in 100 m depth bins
  rates_profiles.100m <- volumes.df.100  %>% 
    # combine volume and 100 m bin sums (note that bins with zero values mean no Calanus spp observed)
    left_join(rates_profiles, by = join_by(sample_id, Depth_100m)) %>% 
    filter(!is.na(station_year)) %>% 
    # replace NA with 0
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>% 
    # concentration by volume (m3)
    mutate(abundance_m3 = abundance/Sampled_volume_m3,
           biomass_ugC_m3 = biomass_ugC/Sampled_volume_m3,
           diapause_respirationRate_ugCday_m3 = diapause_respirationRate_ugCday/Sampled_volume_m3,
           active_respirationRate_ugCday_m3 = active_respirationRate_ugCday/Sampled_volume_m3,
           ingestionRate_ugCday_m3_v1 = ingestionRate_ugCday_v1/Sampled_volume_m3,
           egestionRate_ugCday_m3_v1 = egestionRate_ugCday_v1/Sampled_volume_m3,
           ingestionRate_ugCday_m3_v2 = ingestionRate_ugCday_v2/Sampled_volume_m3,
           egestionRate_ugCday_m3_v2 = egestionRate_ugCday_v2/Sampled_volume_m3) %>% 
    # concentration by area (m2), convert mg C to g C
    mutate(abundance_m2 = abundance_m3 * depth_height_m,
           biomass_gC_m2 = biomass_ugC_m3 * depth_height_m / 1000000,
           diapause_respirationRate_gCday_m2 = diapause_respirationRate_ugCday_m3 * depth_height_m / 1000000,
           active_respirationRate_gCday_m2 = active_respirationRate_ugCday_m3 * depth_height_m / 1000000,
           ingestionRate_gCday_m2_v1 = ingestionRate_ugCday_m3_v1 * depth_height_m / 1000000,
           egestionRate_gCday_m2_v1 = egestionRate_ugCday_m3_v1 * depth_height_m / 1000000,
           ingestionRate_gCday_m2_v2 = ingestionRate_ugCday_m3_v2 * depth_height_m / 1000000,
           egestionRate_gCday_m2_v2 = egestionRate_ugCday_m3_v2 * depth_height_m / 1000000
           ) %>% 
    # Exclude the columns that are not concentrations
    select(-c(abundance, biomass_ugC, diapause_respirationRate_ugCday,
              active_respirationRate_ugCday, ingestionRate_ugCday_v1, egestionRate_ugCday_v1,
              ingestionRate_ugCday_v2, egestionRate_ugCday_v2))
  

# Step 3. Combine profiles with the same sample_stationid_ed
  rates_profiles.100m <- rates_profiles.100m %>% 
    group_by(region.inuk, station_year, Depth_100m) %>% 
    # Average all variables per 100m layer
    summarise(across(where(is.numeric),  
                     ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
              nprofiles = n(),
              .groups = "drop") %>% 
    # Establish factors
    mutate(Depth_100m = factor(Depth_100m, levels = seq(0,2500,100))) 
  
    
  # Step 4. Vertically integrate each profile (/m2)
  profiles_total_daily_C <- rates_profiles.100m %>% 
    group_by(region.inuk, station_year) %>% 
    summarise(n100bins = n(),
              Sampled_volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
              abundance_m2 = sum(abundance_m2, na.rm = T),
              biomass_gC_m2 = sum(biomass_gC_m2),
              # note that diapause respiration is not adjusted for diapause duration yet
              diapause_respirationRate_gCday_m2 = sum(diapause_respirationRate_gCday_m2),
              active_respirationRate_gCday_m2 = sum(active_respirationRate_gCday_m2),
              ingestionRate_gCday_m2_v1 = sum(ingestionRate_gCday_m2_v1),
              egestionRate_gCday_m2_v1 = sum(egestionRate_gCday_m2_v1),
              ingestionRate_gCday_m2_v2 = sum(ingestionRate_gCday_m2_v2),
              egestionRate_gCday_m2_v2 = sum(egestionRate_gCday_m2_v2),
              .groups = "drop") %>% 
    # % of biomass ingested per day
    mutate(perc_ingested_v1 = ingestionRate_gCday_m2_v1/biomass_gC_m2 * 100,
           perc_ingested_v2 = ingestionRate_gCday_m2_v2/biomass_gC_m2 * 100)

  # In these calculations ~2.2-4.3%  (mean ~3%) of C biomass is ingested per day
  profiles_total_daily_C %>% 
    select(perc_ingested_v1, perc_ingested_v2) %>% 
    summary()
```

# Estimate NPP consumption and contribution to POC flux (fecal pellet) 
Note that using the version 2 equations lead to a similar NPP consumption but increases the fecal pellet production by double since the assmilation efficiency is lower 
```{r}
# Calculate  regional averages?
# TODO why is total abudnance and biomass not exactly the same?
region_total_daily_c <- profiles_total_daily_C %>% 
  group_by(region.inuk) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(),
            across(where(is.numeric),  
                   ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            nprofiles = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # Calculate total values for say 90 days of grazing
  mutate(ingested_90d_gC_m2_v1 = ingestionRate_gCday_m2_v1 * 90,
         ingested_90d_gC_m2_v2 = ingestionRate_gCday_m2_v2 * 90,
         egested_90d_gC_m2_v1 = egestionRate_gCday_m2_v1 * 90,
         egested_90d_gC_m2_v2 = egestionRate_gCday_m2_v2 * 90)

# Add NPP and POC in g C m-2 yr-1 
region_clim_npp <- read.csv("tables/NPP_ratio_20260528.csv") %>% 
  left_join(region_rename %>% select(reg.inuk, region.inuk)) %>% 
  select(region.inuk, NPP_mean, NPP_sd, 
         days_mean, days_sd,
         POC_flux) # this is the POC flux averaged for the regions

region_total_C_budget <- region_total_daily_c %>% 
  left_join(region_clim_npp, by = "region.inuk") %>% 
  # % NPP grazed
  mutate(perc_NPP_grazed_90d_v1 = ingested_90d_gC_m2_v1 / NPP_mean * 100,
         perc_NPP_grazed_90d_v2 = ingested_90d_gC_m2_v2 / NPP_mean  * 100) %>% 
  # % of POC from fecal pellets (assuming 90% is remineralized in upper 200 m)
  mutate(perc_POC_fpc_90d_v1 = egested_90d_gC_m2_v1 / POC_flux * 100 * .1,
         perc_POC_fpc_90d_v2 = egested_90d_gC_m2_v2 / POC_flux * 100 * .1)

# write.csv(region_total_C_budget,
#           file = "tables/rough_calanus_carbon_budget_20260602.csv")
```


# Simply check diapause duration and temperatures
```{r}
calanus.traits <- indiv_traits %>% 
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") %>% 
  filter(sample_id %in% Amund_UVP6_meta$sample_id)

ggplot(calanus.traits, aes(x = temperature_kelvin-273.15,
                           y = diapauseDuration_day)) +

```


# Calculating average fluxes weighted by surface area
```{r}
surf_area_100Iso <- df.region %>% 
  select(region.inuktitut, region.inuk, n,
         abundance_m2_mean, biomass_gC_m2_mean, waxester_gC_m2_mean,
         LPC_flux = total_gC_flux_m2_mean) %>% 
  mutate(area_km2 = c(12363, 46597, 23906, 85830, 88089, 10768, 68205)) %>% 
  left_join(region_total_C_budget %>% 
              select(region.inuk,
                     NPP_mean, POC_flux,
                     active_respirationRate_gCday_m2,
                     ingestionRate_gCday_m2_v1,
                     egestionRate_gCday_m2_v1,
                     perc_ingested_v1),
            by = "region.inuk") %>% 
  relocate(area_km2, .after = "n")

# Calculate weighted averages according to surface area
ave.C.budget <- surf_area_100Iso %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(region.inuktitut, region.inuk, area_km2),
               names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>% 
  group_by(variable) %>% 
  summarise(value_wmean = weighted.mean(value, area_km2),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(value_wmean = format(value_wmean, scientific = FALSE))


```
